title: Enforce explicit database targets and disabled staging integrations
summary: Add startup, request, client and worker guards; staging must use its own reviewed target and credential bindings.

changes.detail: Explicit APP_ENV policy, exact target allowlists, reviewed SHA256 credential bindings, startup/request guards and isolated staging worker support.
Remove admin signing and privileged-client fallbacks; reject live PayPal outside production and invalid payment environments. Block nonproduction external secrets, paid activation and cron endpoints.
Disable legacy direct RPC worker entry points and remove ordinary-build placeholder credentials.
Keep email routes importable when integrations are disabled; nonproduction telemetry and indexing are disabled. Existing secrets, migration files and previous reports are preserved.

validation.name: Focused regression, types, lint and isolated build
validation.detail: Pending. No hosted acceptance, deployment, migration, worker activation or paid requests authorized.
